When people discuss Indian languages, Gujarati is often overlooked. Possibly because as a culture, Gujaratis have rarely been the loudest in the room, they've been too busy building empires. From Tata's steel to Gandhi's revolution, from diamond markets in Antwerp to motels across America, this "business community" has quietly shaped the modern world.
